projects.title: Mass Parent Tool
bullets: Wrote a Unity editor tool in C# to batch-parent objects, replacing a manual step teammates repeated during builds.
Kept the tool small, editing two files, so it could drop into any Unity project without setup.

projects.title: Ludum Dare 49 Entry
bullets: Built a game submission for a five-day Ludum Dare jam in C#, HLSL and ShaderLab, writing custom shaders.
Iterated the build across the jam's active days, shipping a playable entry under a tight deadline.

projects.title: Unity Terminal
bullets: Wrote a Python command-line tool that operates Unity Hub functions from the terminal.
Found more interest in building support tooling than gameplay code, a signal behind later enabling teams instead of just shipping features.

leadership.title: Tools Contributor
bullets: During a jam, noticed teammates repeatedly parenting objects by hand in the Unity editor and wrote a tool to batch it.
Extended the habit after peers asked for a way to launch Unity projects without opening the Hub GUI.
